candidates.raw_text: Although both KC and hepatocytes demonstrate comparable high and rapid uptake of mRNA‐LNP and siRNA‐LNP in vivo, the translation of Egfp mRNA occurs exclusively in hepatocytes during intravital imaging

evidence.quote: Although both KC and hepatocytes demonstrate comparable high and rapid uptake of mRNA‐LNP and siRNA‐LNP in vivo, the translation of Egfp mRNA occurs exclusively in hepatocytes during intravital imaging.

dispositions.reason: The candidate reports two supported, semantically distinct intravital-imaging results: comparable high and rapid LNP uptake by Kupffer cells and hepatocytes, and EGFP mRNA translation exclusively in hepatocytes.
